The Platform Model

Infrastructure. Not a staffing agency.

Ownlybiz provides the tools. You run the practice. Your clients, your pricing, your business — always.

🏛️

Independent Practice

You are an independent professional, not an Ownlybiz employee or contractor. Ownlybiz provides infrastructure only.

⚖️

Legal Clarity

You accept full responsibility for your services, credentials, and compliance. Clients are hiring you — not Ownlybiz.

💳

Direct Payments

Connect your own Stripe Connect or PayPal Business account. Client payments flow directly to you, minus a transparent platform fee.

⏱️

Free Minutes: Your Tool

Offer 0–10 free intro minutes per session type. Clients experience your value first. You control the offer — you absorb the cost.

Billing Modes

Four ways to charge. Mix and match.

Every expert and client interaction is different. Ownlybiz gives you flexible billing to match your practice model.

Most Popular
⏱️

Per Minute

Metered every 60 seconds for chat, voice, or video. Client billed continuously — perfect for open-ended conversations.

📌

Fixed Session

Flat fee paid upfront for a defined session length. Simple, predictable pricing both sides appreciate.

📦

Package Bundle

Multiple sessions sold as a package, paid upfront. Great for coaching programs and ongoing engagements.

✍️

Written / Async

Client submits a question, you write a detailed response. Flat fee, no scheduling required. Perfect for research and analysis.

Frequently asked questions

What is the platform fee and when is it charged? ↓
The platform fee is a percentage deducted automatically from each session payment. Starter experts pay 12%, Pro pays 8%, Scale pays 5%. The fee is shown transparently in your dashboard — you always see exactly what you earned and what Ownlybiz kept.
How do I get paid? ↓
Connect your own Stripe Connect, PayPal Business, or Coinbase Commerce account. Client payments flow directly to your payment account — Ownlybiz deducts the platform fee from each transaction. You receive payouts on your normal Stripe/PayPal schedule.
Can I use my own domain? ↓
Yes. You get a free subdomain (yourname.ownlybiz.com) instantly. On Pro and Scale plans, connect any custom domain — we handle DNS, SSL, and routing. Takes about 5 minutes in your dashboard.
Am I an employee of Ownlybiz? ↓
No. You are an independent professional using Ownlybiz's technology platform. Ownlybiz is not your employer, franchisor, or staffing agency. All services are provided by you, to your clients, under your own responsibility.
What happens after the 2-month free trial? ↓
After 2 months, Starter experts continue free with the 12% platform fee. Pro and Scale plans require a monthly or annual subscription. We'll give you 30 days notice before any charges — no surprises.

About this Expert

Expert
👩‍💼

I'm Expert — a business strategist with over 8 years of hands-on experience helping companies from Series A startups to Fortune 500 enterprises unlock growth, improve operations, and build competitive advantage.

I hold an MBA from Wharton and a Certified Management Consultant (CMC) designation. I've worked with clients across diverse industries and backgrounds including technology, retail, healthcare, and financial services.

Before launching my independent consulting practice, I served as Head of Strategy at a global management consultancy for six years. I left to do the work I love most: direct, impactful engagements with business leaders who want clear thinking, honest feedback, and practical results — not polished decks.

When I'm not in sessions, I'm writing about business strategy on Substack and hosting a bi-weekly webinar series for founders navigating their first major growth phase.

How Stripe Connect Works for Ownlybiz
You collect the platform fee automatically — no manual work
👤

e.g. $100 for a session
⚡
Stripe splits it
Instantly, automatically
💰
You get 20%, expert 80%

📋 Setup Steps (5 minutes):
1
Go to stripe.com → Create a free account (or log in)
2
In Stripe: click Developers → API Keys
3
Copy your Secret key (sk_live_...) and Publishable key (pk_live_...)
4
Paste them below → click Save Configuration
5
In Stripe: enable Connect (for splitting payments with experts) → Stripe will guide you through business verification
💡 Test mode first: Use your test keys (sk_test_... / pk_test_...) to try everything without real money. Switch to live keys when you're ready to go live.
Platform Payment Accounts All platform revenue flows to these accounts

Session fees, subscription revenue, and domain sales are collected here. Connect at least one account before going live. Stripe is required for expert payouts (Connect).
